brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to develop rough drafts into polished, editable, runnable interfaces
brief.concept: Create an unmistakable uppercase D monogram from three collaborative parts. A strong vertical spine suggests the aligned edges of stacked drafts and version history; two slightly offset curved facets join it to complete the D bowl, suggesting successive ideas converging into one product; at their seam, one crisp folded-corner notch or small radiant negative-space cut expresses inspiration being triggered. The full outer silhouette must read as capital D immediately. Keep the draft reference abstract and structural, not a literal document illustration. Do not add lowercase d, the full word, writing lines, browser windows, robots, cursors, code brackets, chat bubbles, flowers, pinwheels, or generic AI sparkle symbols
brief.style: Ownable contemporary uppercase-D brand monogram; inventive, optimistic, collaborative, and design-literate. Compact flat-vector construction with three large interlocking color fields and one simple cutout, strong silhouette, readable at 16 px, and viable as a one-color mark. No scene, gradients, gloss, texture, thin lines, tiny details, shadows, enclosing tile, or mockup
brief.palette: deep creative violet #5D46E8, clear sky blue #35B9F2, warm coral #FF684D, small sun-yellow accent #FFC247; no green
